edit.description: fold the reserved (requirement, name) node into the root/<kind>/<name> member node; satisfies, mention and runs arcs bind it
explain's requirement/member split and blast-radius walks read the one node
fill and dangling-satisfies read the folded node

summary: a requirement is one graph node, its root/<kind>/<name> member: satisfies and mention arcs and root containment meet there, so member-grain clauses and explain see its satisfiers
acceptance: a requirement subkind's member node carries the satisfies arcs naming it; explain of root/<kind>/<name> lists its satisfiers; fill and dangling verdicts unchanged
tests: a satisfies arc and root containment land on one requirement node
explain of a requirement subkind member address lists its satisfiers
pins: an unfilled requirement still draws the fill finding
notes: From REQUIREMENT-IS-A-ROOT-HOSTED-NESTED-MEMBER build note (525342e0): graph keeps two nodes, so a member-grain degree/expect over a requirement subkind counts no satisfies arcs (vacuous). 0107: one grammar reads it everywhere.
